value: **Involvement**: Teachers collaborated as design partners in collaborative design sessions to provide pedagogical domain expertise, define requirements, evaluate usability, and iteratively refine educational technology tools and online learning environments. **Evidence**: "The Rehacer el mundo project is a participatory design project with youth, museum educators, artists, and researchers to engage Latine and other historically marginalized youth and families in developing a youth- professional collaborative art exhibit."
